# Live Lingua

> > Live Lingua provides free language learning resources and online tutoring for Spanish, French, Korean, and dozens of other languages with native-speaking instructors.

Live Lingua offers comprehensive language education through multiple formats: free downloadable courses with audio lessons, verb conjugation references, vocabulary lists, podcasts, and one-on-one tutoring with certified teachers. The platform specializes in Spanish learning resources including the Live Lingua Spanish Podcast, extensive verb conjugation charts, and specialized courses for business, medical, and tourism professionals.

## Key Topics

- Spanish verb conjugation
- Language learning courses
- Native speaker tutors
- Free language resources
- DELF French certification
- Spanish grammar reference
- Vocabulary building
- Audio lessons and podcasts
- Irregular verbs
- Business and medical Spanish
- Korean Hangul instruction
- Verb tenses and charts
- Beginner language courses
- Online language tutoring

## Language Courses & Learning Resources

- [Live Lingua Spanish Podcast - A full Spanish course... in podcast form.](https://www.livelingua.com/podcast): Free Spanish audio course podcast with daily episodes for learners
- [Specialized Spanish Courses | Live Lingua](https://www.livelingua.com/specialized-courses): Professional Spanish courses: business, medical, tourism, teacher training
- [Learn Korean Free: 7 Online Korean Courses | Live Lingua](https://www.livelingua.com/korean/lessons): Free Korean courses: 7 ebooks and audio lessons with Hangul instruction
- [DELF exam tutors online | Award-Winning | Live Lingua](https://www.livelingua.com/french/delf): DELF French certification exam prep with native tutors online
- [Learn Zarma (Djerma) Free: 3 Online Zarma Courses | Live Lingua](https://www.livelingua.com/courses/Zarma/Djerma): Free Zarma (Djerma) courses: 3 ebooks and audio lessons for Niger language

## Spanish Vocabulary Lists

- [Basic Words | 54 Spanish Vocabulary Words | Live Lingua](https://www.livelingua.com/vocabulary/basic): 54 basic Spanish vocabulary words: greetings, common phrases, translations
- [Shapes | 15 Spanish Vocabulary Words | Live Lingua](https://www.livelingua.com/vocabulary/shapes): 15 Spanish vocabulary words for shapes with English translations
